title: Identifying Macro Causal Effects in a C-DMG over ADMGs
abstract: arXiv:2504.01551v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Causal effect identification using causal graphs is a fundamental challenge in causal inference. While extensive research has been conducted in this area, most existing methods assume the availability of fully specified directed acyclic graphs or acyclic directed mixed graphs. However, in complex domains such as medicine and epidemiology, complete causal knowledge is often unavailable, and only partial information about the system is accessible. This paper focuses on causal effect identification within partially specified causal graphs, with particular emphasis on cluster-directed mixed graphs (C-DMGs) which can represent many different acyclic directed mixed graphs (ADMGs). These graphs provide a higher-level representation of causal relationships by grouping variables into clusters, offering a more practical approach for handling complex systems. translated_title: 在ADMG之上的C-DMG中识别宏观因果效应
translated_abstract: 使用因果图进行因果效应识别是因果推断中的一项基本挑战。尽管该领域已有大量研究，但现有方法大多假设可以获得完全指定的有向无环图或无环有向混合图（ADMG）。然而，在医学和流行病学等复杂领域中，完整的因果知识往往不可得，只能获取系统的部分信息。本文聚焦于在部分指定的因果图上进行因果效应识别，特别关注聚类有向混合图（C-DMG），它可以表示多种不同的无环有向混合图（ADMG）。这类图通过将变量分组为聚类，为因果关系提供了更高层次的表示，为处理复杂系统提供了更实用的方法。与完全指定的ADMG不同，C-DMG可以包含环，这使其分析变得更加复杂。
tldr: 本文提出在聚类有向混合图（C-DMG）中识别宏观因果效应的方法，解决了在仅有部分因果知识可用时，通过变量聚类的高层次表示来处理可含环的复杂系统的因果效应识别问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes methods for identifying macro causal effects in cluster-directed mixed graphs (C-DMGs), enabling causal effect identification in complex systems with partial causal knowledge through higher-level cluster-based representations that may contain cycles.
